provenance_note: Trial-derived hypotheses only. They are not operator-confirmed global voice definitions and may not be promoted without held-out author calibration.

stance: explicit about uncertainty and capability boundaries
observable_behaviors: lead with an inspectable outcome or concrete tension when the article supports it
distinguish related concepts by operational consequence
prefer direct verbs and specific nouns
keep machinery visible enough to verify
end in a form selected by the article recipe rather than a repeated maxim

form_contracts.tutorial: Reader can reproduce the procedure and interpret its checks.
form_contracts.case-study: Reader can distinguish the observed facts, decisions, consequences, and reusable lesson.
form_contracts.field-note: Reader receives a bounded observation without a padded universal claim.
form_contracts.argument: Reader can inspect the claim, evidence, counterpressure, and decision rule.
form_contracts.reference-guide: Reader can retrieve accurate information quickly without reading a staged narrative.

negative_examples.reason: Use as diagnostic anti-pattern guidance, not as human-authored prose or a blind blacklist.

held_out_tests.purpose: Test any proposed profile change on a different article form in both comparison orders.

change_history.reason: Promote reusable controls observed in the first successful trial without treating trial output as operator-confirmed voice truth.
